[EN] I heard {@LinkCreature:77#3002#Paruru}'s pets, Sweetie and Prince ran off again today.

You should take this smoked jerky.

Just in case.
[ES] Escuché que las mascotas de {@LinkCreature:77#3002#Paruru}, Sweetie y Prince, volvieron a escaparse hoy.

Deberías llevarte esta carne seca ahumada.

Por si acaso.

[EN] Sweetie and Prince ran away—again!

It's possible they associate this sort of acting out with getting fed tasty bits of smoked meat. Let's find out. Find the dogs and lure them home with some smoked jerky.

Please. Done begging now.
[ES] ¡Sweetie y Prince se escaparon, otra vez!

Es posible que asocien este tipo de travesuras con recibir trozos deliciosos de carne ahumada. Vamos a averiguarlo. Encuentra a los perros y atráelos de vuelta a casa con algo de carne seca ahumada.

Por favor. Ya terminé de rogar.

[EN] (The dog appears overjoyed to see you and the smoked jerky.)

[EN] Sweetie came back. I scolded her with lots of hugs and jerky. That'll teach her.

Still no sign of Prince, though. You should find him next.
[ES] Sweetie volvió. La regañé con muchos abrazos y carne seca. Eso le enseñará.

Aun así, ni rastro de Prince. Deberías buscarlo a él ahora.

[EN] Thanks for finding Prince. I gave him the same harsh punishment I gave Sweetie. He nearly broke his tail wagging it.

You have to be firm, but fair.
[ES] Gracias por encontrar a Prince. Le di el mismo castigo severo que le di a Sweetie. Casi se rompió la cola de tanto moverla.

Hay que ser firme, pero justo.
